notes: Prose trades ES and binding is ES=F 1h, so binding is coherent, and all hardcoded levels (6430.75, 6455-6465, 6496.25, 6508.75) lie inside the frozen ES_F_1h.pkl Close range 4863-7643.25 (first Close >= 6430 on 2025-07-27, ~4800 bars close above 6496.25), so the levels are meaningful. Entry is unpinned: condition 2 'a pullback from the key support at 6430.75 has occurred, and the price has started to recover' defines neither pullback depth nor recovery, and the breakout must come 'with increased volume' / 'rising trading volume' with no lookback or threshold (indicator params also unpinned; the SMA(200) and NVDA 183-185 filters are 'optional', another free choice). Exit is unpinned: stop 'can be placed at the lower boundary of the zone, for example, at 6455' plus an alternative exit on 'signs of a reversal downward ... bearish candlestick pattern on increased volume'. Sizing is a 1-2% risk range, not a value; prose demands 'timeframes from 4 hours and higher' against a 1h binding (timeframe-mismatch); and the mandatory 'trades are not executed during the release of major news (such as NVDA earnings)' rule requires an external earnings calendar. The NVDA cross-asset filter is explicitly optional so a single-feed implementation is possible, but whether implementers include it is itself a divergence source.
